assertion.statement: Restriction of the evaluated cohomology to the exact full-Tate/ring-class/quadratic kernel is injective on the characteristic-zero tests; residual H0 vanishing instead follows from moving inertia and does not assert residual irreducibility.
assertion.objects: Evaluated crossed homomorphisms, the exact kernel of sequences trivial on the full Tate and specified class/quadratic fields, and the fixed scalar z.
assertion.hypotheses: Retain the actual evaluated cocycle identities, fixed scalar acting by u^4 central modulo this kernel, u^4-1 nonzero, and the moving-inertia scalar difference t on the residual test.
assertion.quantifiers: Each permitted characteristic-zero inner test and the outer fraction-field test; residual assertion only for the stated scalar-inertia invariants.
assertion.parameter_range: Characteristic-zero coefficients where u^4-1 is invertible; residual coefficient field F2((t)) for the separate H0 assertion.
assertion.uniformity: Uses the one fixed scalar already constructed for the fixed elliptic curve; no new field-dependent exponent.
assertion.constants: The same nonzero scalar u^4-1 and residual unit t.
assertion.normalizations: z is central modulo the exact kernel, not itself an element of the kernel. A cocycle vanishing on the kernel satisfies (u^4-1)b(g)=(g-1)b(z).
assertion.exceptional_cases: No residual restriction-injectivity or rank-two localization is claimed; E[2] remains trivial rank2 and residual multiplicity is retained.
assertion.limit_order: Construct the fixed scalar and evaluated cocycle first, restrict to the exact kernel, invert u^4-1 only in characteristic zero; treat residual inertia separately.
